message.content:
This vertical rectangular editorial illustration features a magazine cover. The masthead, "TEMPO," is printed in large, white, sans-serif uppercase letters across the top center. Below it is the text "EDISI 13-19 MEI 2013". Above the masthead, smaller text reads "EDISI KHUSUS: TRAGEDI MEI 1998-2013".

The main image is a close-up, slightly blurred photograph of a man with dark, curly hair and a light complexion. He is shown from the chest up, facing forward and slightly to the right. His mouth is slightly open, showing teeth. His hands are visible in the lower right, with fingers intertwined. He wears a light-colored, collared shirt.

Large white text in the lower left reads "Teka-teki Wiji Thukul". Above this, a paragraph in a smaller black serif font states: "Ia hilang sekitar prahara Mei 1998. Diburu Kopassus, penyair ini juga menjadi target operasi kelompok lain. Siapa yang telah menghabisinya?".

A red vertical strip on the left edge contains the vertical text "TEMPO TEKA-TEKI WIJI THUKUL". A black circle in the upper left corner contains white text about a bonus book. At the bottom, a barcode and price information are visible.
